sections.excerpt:

to us from the sale of the securities in this offering will be approximately $6.0 million, after deducting
the placement agent fees and estimated offering expenses. We intend to use the net proceeds
we receive from this offering for general corporate purposes, including working capital. Our management will have broad discretion in
the application of the net proceeds. As of the date of this prospectus,
